title: Multi-LED Configuration Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Beginning electronics and LED systems
description: An interactive four-column infographic comparing parallel LED branches, strips, matrices, and chasers.

learningObjectives: Explain how wiring and control strategy differ among parallel LEDs, strips, matrices, and chaser circuits.

keyQuestions: When does each LED need its own resistor?
How do matrices and chasers reduce or sequence control connections?
commonMisconceptions: Parallel LEDs can safely share one resistor in every situation.
An LED matrix drives every LED continuously.
